pages.title: Potions
pages.text: With the numerous materials obtainable with the Risus, there are a few that are perfect for the creation of potions. $(br)$(br) - To start, a $(l:blocks/cinderglee#camp)$(c)$(o)Cinderglee Campfire$() will make a Potion of Life Smouldering, applying both Strength and $(l:blocks/cinderglee)$(c)$(o)Existential Burn$(). $(br)$(br) - By using a $(l:weapons/killjoy)$(c)$(o)Killjoy$() a Potion of Clotting can be created. This potion will

cause the $(l:blocks/blood)$(c)$(o)Bloodclogged$() effect.$(br)$(br) - A $(l:tools/litter)$(c)$(o)Light Dropping$() can be used to make a Potion of Radiance, which applies the same Glowing effect as Spectral Arrows do. $(br)$(br) - $(l:tools/lucky_charm)$(c)$(o)Lucky Charms and Wretched Charms$() can be used to brew Potions of Luck and Misfortune respectively, causing a Luck increase or decrease. $(br)$(br) - Refining a Guilty Apple through brewing will result in a $(l:materials/guilty_apple)$(c)$(o)Potion of Love$().

- Alongside all of its other uses, the $(l:materials/memory_core)$(c)$(o)Memory Core$() can also be made into a Potion of Forgetfulness, which causes short term Amnesia. When used against monsters, it will cause them to forget their target. $(br)$(br) - The $(l:tools/hand_of_greed)$(c)$(o)Hand Of Greed$() from Holders can be turned into a Potion of Golden Glory, which applies the Gold Rush effect. When a creature or a person is under this effect, they have a chance to drop Gold upon their death. If this potion is inverted by adding a Fermented

Spider Eye, it will turn into a Potion of The Copper Age, with the Verdigris Vehemence effect. This will cause the dead to drop Copper. $(br)$(br) - A $(l:blocks/heart_transplant)$(c)$(o)Heart Transplant$() can be brewed into a Potion of Transfusion, offering a temporary Health Boost.
